headline: Billions spent on Możejki. What will Orlen do? Minister speaks up
summary: Orlen should not sell its Mažeikiai refinery at present, state assets minister Wojciech Balczun said, citing the geopolitical situation and security of the Baltic states. The company is analysing the future of the costly investment.
why: Orlen is Poland's state-controlled oil refiner and retailer, and the Mažeikiai refinery in Lithuania is one of its major downstream assets. Refinery sale decisions affect the group's capital allocation.

impacts.name: Orlen
impacts.why: A decision on whether to sell the refinery would affect Orlen's asset portfolio and the value of its costly Baltic investment.
